Job Title: Software Engineer 2
Posting Start Date: 7/20/26
Job Location(s): Bengaluru
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.


Requisition ID: 77978


Job Description:
**Description**
---------------

Skyworks Solutions is seeking a highly motivated multidisciplinary individual to drive software/AI development and workflows automation to accelerate innovation across our semiconductor products. This role sits at the intersection of muti\-tier software product and platform development and EDA tools, silicon design flows, and scalable software systems. Your work will make a direct impact on company's top and bottom line.


The ideal candidate has hands‑on experience building innovative products from ground up, automate processes, and thrives in a collaborative environment.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain software products and platform for semiconductor design automation supporting design, tapeout and post\-tapeout workflows
* Develop software / AI solutions to improve productivity, quality, reliability and design reuse.
* Integrate commercial EDA tools via API/CLI into Skyworks design flows
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define automation requirements.
* Debug design flow issues and improve tool reliability and scalability.
* Define and develop good software development practices
* Support semiconductor tape‑out schedules and continuous improvement initiatives
* Use AI/ML to optimize process, built more predictability, reliability across the process flows.
**Required Experience and Skills**
----------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3\-5 years of relevant solid industry Full\-stack software development experience
* Stong experience with software tech\-stack \- UI (React.js, QT). Backend (Python, C\+\+, Java), Databases (Azure SQL, Databricks)
* Experience with workflow automation
* Experience using Machine learning models to solve complex challenges.
* Experience developing custom AI agents, MCP servers
* Experience leading DevOps (github, jenkins)
* Experience hositng application on web server
* Confortable working with both Linux and Windows environment
* Experience with version control systems such as Git and/or Perforce/CI/CD

#### **Software Engineering \& Operations**

* Ability to host, operate, and scale web‑based software tools in Unix/Linux environments
* Experience setting up and maintaining Apache (or similar) web servers in on‑premises environments
* Working knowledge building software product which are secure by design

#### **Cloud \& Modern Tooling**

* Experience or familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Experience using AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar) to improve productivity and automation
**Desired Experience and Skills**
---------------------------------

* Domain experience in semiconductor
* Exposure to large‑scale EDA compute environments or regression infrastructures
* Experience supporting hybrid on‑prem \+ cloud engineering platforms
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts applied to EDA flows and tooling

\#LIPR1


Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026\.

We are seeking a highly skilled Engineer with a strong background in Generative AI (GenAI) Agents to lead innovative projects in the realm of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing complex projects leveraging cutting\-edge technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, Agentic AI, and MLOps. * **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

* Lead and manage AI and Machine Learning projects from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

* Facilitate communication between stakeholders, clients, engineering teams, and executive leadership.

* Monitor project progress and performance, making adjustments as needed to ensure delivery success.
* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies proactively.
* Mentor and guide junior project managers, technical leads, and team members.
* Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI technologies and best practices.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Proven experience managing AI and Machine Learning projects, specifically involving GenAI Agents.
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, and Agentic AI.
* Hands\-on experience with MLOps practices, tools, and AI deployment frameworks.
* Strong proficiency with AWS services including Agentcore, Bedrock, ECS/EKS, Lambda, DynamoDB, Fargate, and EventBridge.
* Experience with Azure services including Azure ML, Azure Functions, AKS, Databricks, and IoT solutions.
* Excellent project management skills including planning, execution, stakeholder management, governance, and risk management.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Computer Vision projects and AI\-driven applications.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies, Scrum frameworks, and project management tools.
* Knowledge of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certifications are advantageous.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native AI solution architectures and enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience coordinating solution delivery across engineering, data science, product, and business teams.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable AI\-powered solutions.
* Strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent verbal, written, and executive\-level communication skills.
* Experience managing budgets, resource planning, and delivery portfolios.
* Passion for innovation and driving adoption of modern AI technologies.
* Proven ability to deliver high\-quality solutions that exceed stakeholder expectations.
* Strong commitment to continuous learning, operational excellence, and business value realization through AI.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Posted date Sep. 30, 2026
Contract type Full time
Job ID R\-260891
  
**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------


Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.


The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly\-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.


**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------


Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Tech innovators**


Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.


### **Ownership takers**


If you're a self\-aware self\-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.


### **Challenge seekers**


Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.


### **Proactive collaborators**


Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260891 **Date posted** 09/30/2026
**GCL: C2**
-----------


**Introduction to role:**


Are you ready to turn enterprise AI into practical outcomes that streamline how we operate and ultimately improve patients’ lives? Do you thrive at the intersection of AI engineering, cloud platforms, and DevOps automation, where ideas move quickly from prototype to production with the right guardrails?


In this role, you will join a high\-performing, digitally savvy team that partners across the enterprise to deliver AI assistants, agents, copilots, and intelligent workflow automation.
